requirements.title: Responsible-Use Deployment Gate
requirements.description: Editing real people is gated at DEPLOYMENT, not at the capability. Public/monetized deployment requires: NSFW/CSAM auto-scan on by default, C2PA provenance on by default (at least for real-person edits), a published Acceptable-Use Policy, a consent affirmation + logging on identity-altering ops, and abuse rate-limiting. Local/personal use is unrestricted; the hard non-goals (no recognition / face-swap / deepfake) remain enforced. Naturalize is low-weight; body/clothing/pose edits are high-weight.
